results.name: Five connected views render with the CR-05 worklist and its provenance chips
Summary counts open exactly the contributing records and Back restores the previous context
Search narrows the worklist and an explicitly selected record outside the results stays visible
The record snapshot shows eleven distinct outcomes with their own sources
A review date cannot be saved without a recorded basis
Completing a review is refused while a commitment has no disposition
A completed review keeps every remaining obligation visible and separate
A technical concern links to the existing case instead of creating a second record
A new referral is prepared, submitted, returned, corrected, resubmitted and accepted
Training applicability is flagged and the five training states stay separate
The training role cannot see, search or count the second customer
Linking an MA-05 renewal review never changes the agreement source
A CRM handover is prepared, submitted, lost and recovered without a duplicate opportunity
The chronological history groups source events, reviews, referrals, training and commercial follow-up
A source change retains the completed review and flags the record
A failed save retains the form entries and creates no record
Partial, failed and empty source results never imply an empty workload
Keyboard navigation moves between views and the dialog returns focus to its trigger
Every interactive control meets the 44px touch target and the phone layout does not scroll sideways
Session export and restore validate the saved records and start read-only
A malformed stored session is preserved for export rather than discarded
